text: わたしね　ナツメさん　みたいに　なりたーい！

structure.jp: ナツメさん　みたいに

patterns.name: 〜みたいに
patterns.span: ナツメさん　みたいに
patterns.explanation: みたいに after a name means 'in the same way as' that person. ナツメさん　みたいに　なりたい = 'I want to be like Sabrina'

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it; the sound is stretched out here in excitement. なりたーい = 'I waaant to become'
